details.description: Kesh King is the premier brand in Ayurvedic hair care, offering a range of scalp and hair medicine products certified by governmental bodies to solve hair problems from the root. The Kesh King Scalp and Hair Medicine Anti-Hairfall Shampoo is a unique and potent Ayurvedic formula, infused with the goodness of Aloe and 21 Ayurvedic herbs. This shampoo penetrates the upper layer of the scalp to provide deep nourishment to both the scalp and hair follicles, leading to soft, shiny, and silky hair that is visibly healthier and more vibrant. Suitable for daily use, this gentle, herbal preparation nourishes hair from the roots, helping to reduce hair fall and dandruff without causing any damage or irritation. Experience the transformative power of Ayurvedic hair care with Kesh King.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply Kesh King Shampoo to wet hair.
Gently massage the scalp for a good lather.
Rinse thoroughly with water.
Apply Kesh King Conditioner and rinse thoroughly after 1-3 minutes.

details.description:
Kesh King Anti-Dandruff Shampoo brings together the power of Ayurvedic wisdom and scientific innovation, enriched with 21 Ayurvedic herbs and Bio-Niacinamide to eliminate the root cause of dandruff while keeping the scalp healthy and balanced.
Clinically proven to deliver real results, 98% of users saw visible dandruff reduction in just 2 weeks*, and 99% said this anti-dandruff shampoo prevented dandruff from coming back^, giving you lasting relief instead of temporary fixes. Bio-Niacinamide helps maintain the scalp's natural moisture level, preventing the dryness that often triggers flaking, while Karanja works to control dandruff at its source. Neem soothes and reduces scalp itchiness, and Lemon helps prevent dandruff from returning, keeping your scalp fresh and flake-free for longer.
Free from parabens, artificial colors, and harsh chemicals, this gentle yet effective formula is suitable for regular use by both men and women, making it easy to fit into your everyday hair care routine. Certified by the International Hair Institute, Kesh King Anti-Dandruff Shampoo doesn't just mask dandruff — it works to restore your scalp's natural health, leaving it calmer, cleaner, and visibly flake-free wash after wash.
*Based on clinical study over 2 weeks. ^Based on consumer perception study.
details.usageInstructions: Apply To Wet Hair, Massage Into Scalp, Rinse. For Best Results, Use After Kesh King Gold Oil.

details.description: Kesh King Onion Oil is a unique and potent blend of 21 rare ayurvedic herbs and Onion Oil that works together to revive your crowning glory. It has been designed for optimal hair growth, hair fall control & curing other hair problems. Regular use helps improve hair's texture making it fuller, shinier & stronger.
details.usageInstructions:
Remove the plug inside the cap.
Take 3 - 5ml of Kesh King Onion Oil in your palm & apply it to the roots of the hair using your fingertips.
Gently massage and work from root to tip of the hair.
Leave it overnight or for a few hours before washing it off using Kesh King Onion Shampoo.

details.description: Kesh King Anti Hairfall Conditioner is an ayurvedic herbal conditioner that combines the goodness of Aloe Vera with a powerful blend of 21 Ayurvedic herbs, including Bhringraja, Tulsi, Neem, and Shikakai, to effectively reduce hair fall and control frizz. Specially formulated as a hair fall control conditioner, it works to strengthen hair from the root, minimizing breakage-related hair fall while making hair easier to detangle, manage, and style. This deeply nourishing conditioner hydrates and moisturizes dry, damaged hair, leaving it silky, shiny, and smooth after every wash. Beyond conditioning the hair strands, it also revitalizes and nourishes the scalp, helping combat scalp infections and creating a healthy environment that supports stronger hair roots and encourages natural hair growth. Free from parabens, sulfates, and silicones, this gentle herbal conditioner is FDA-approved and safe for regular, everyday use on all hair types, for both men and women. For best results, use daily after shampooing — apply along the length of the hair and rinse after 1–3 minutes. Pair it with Kesh King Ayurvedic Anti Hair Fall Oil and Kesh King Ayurvedic Anti Hair Fall Shampoo to build a complete Ayurvedic hair care regimen that targets hair fall at the source while enhancing overall hair health and shine. Experience the transformation to soft, smooth, and manageable hair with Kesh King — your trusted partner in ayurvedic hair care.
details.usageInstructions:
After shampooing, apply Kesh King Conditioner along the length of your hair and rinse thoroughly after 1–3 minutes.
For best results, use daily after Kesh King Shampoo.
